data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 is reported in the technical provisions note. The report does not provide a clear, standalone GROSS quantitative movement labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' that can be unambiguously extracted; therefore a gross prior-year development figure cannot be determined from the available pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Technical Provisions table 'At 1 January 2019' (page 25). The report images provided do not include a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or an explicit gross prior-year development number. The statements that describe prior year 'net releases' are net of reinsurance and therefore not acceptable as the primary source per instructions. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 26) but the scanned images are not sufficiently legible to extract reliable cell values for computing prior-year development. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premiums written (653.2) taken from the financial highlights (page 1).
